note: BH-9936 (BH-9926 wave 4). A PR record whose checks object has this many names or more gives the CI word unknown (read GitHub): the jobs worker refuses a new check name at CHECKS_MAX (worker/jobs/src/routes/pr-records.js, 100), so a check of the head can be missing. Keep it equal to the worker's CHECKS_MAX. Read through lane_knob (libs scope) when the caller has it, else from the environment; a value that is not an integer in 1..1000 is 100 and one PRR_CI_KNOB line in logs/prr-shadow.log names it.
